versions.changelog: Tier-2 scoped approvals wording + x402 agent-wallet signing pattern
Security Notes now link the self-serve zero-knowledge verification guide at wundervault.com/verify
Document the file-write/redirect block and the new SSH-only vault_exec (entry_id optional, MCP v1.6.6).
Removed vault_http_post — outbound exfiltration risk. Idea preserved for future work with proper allowlist design.
Added vault_http_post: zero-knowledge HTTP requests with vault secrets injected into headers
v1.5.12: Add first-run onboarding flow — vault_entries_list now drives setup state detection with contact form link, account setup guidance, and /verify page reference.

v1.5.11: Pipe mode documented as hard-blocked. Link to /verify page for checksum and signature. Multi-agent section, revocation note, daemon architecture (ASI03), opt-in env injection (ASI09) added to security notes.

v1.5.10: vault_entry_inject_env is now disabled by default and requires explicit opt-in via dashboard (CIP-021). Added multi-agent setup documentation. Updated security notes to reflect daemon architecture and per-agent credential isolation.

▎ Clarify that Wundervault is a hosted service (invite-only at
  ▎ wundervault.com/contact). Add pinned versioned onboarding script URL with
  ▎ SHA-256 checksum verification (ASI04). Add WV_SETUP_URL env var support to
  ▎ keep setup passphrase out of shell history (ASI03). Recommend Tier 2 for
  ▎ high-impact secrets (ASI02). Clarify MCP tool response non-exposure scope
  ▎ (ASI09). Remove deprecated vault_session_status and vault_session_unlock
  ▎ tools.
Remove session lock tools (vault_session_status, vault_session_unlock). Add vault_rsync. Tier 2 now enabled via wundervault.com dashboard.
Fix vault_entry_get description (does not return plaintext), fix vault_entry_inject_env parameter names, add vault_rsync tool
Add ssh_key_entry_id: SSH key fetched from vault, never written to disk or exposed to agent
Fix: use double quotes around env var in remote curl command so remote shell expands the variable
vault_exec remote_host: inject secrets into SSH remote commands without AcceptEnv config
Fix tool names (vault_entry_get/vault_entries_list); update INSTALL.md to use onboard.py + WUNDERVAULT_CREDENTIALS_FILE; add multi-agent setup docs
Direct link to contact form for invite requests
Updated install instructions — request access via contact form at wundervault.com
Improved description for discoverability — added password, API key, credentials, MCP terms
Initial release — MCP-based secret vault access for OpenClaw agents
